g.text: ① 用户私密输入

g.text: ② 三方秘密统计

g.text: ③ 受保护发布与选规

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 20.945455px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #303038

g.text: ④ 私密检查与更新

text.style: font-size: 18.327273px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #303038

g.text: 可信客户端输入口令

text.style: font-size: 18.327273px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #303038

g.text: 编码并填充至固定长度

text.style: font-size: 18.327273px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #303038

g.text: 每位使用新的随机数

text.style: font-size: 18.327273px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #303038

g.text: 生成三份秘密份额

g.text: 计算方 1

text.style: font-size: 15.709091px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #303038

g.text: 计算方 2

text.style: font-size: 15.709091px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #303038

g.text: 计算方 3

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17.672727px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #303038

g.text: 每方仅接收自己的份额

text.style: font-size: 18.327273px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #303038

g.text: 检查分享关系、位值与填充

text.style: font-size: 18.327273px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #303038

g.text: 绑定同一秘密口令输入

text.style: font-size: 17.018182px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #303038

g.text: 秘密推导 L/U/D/S 结构

text.style: font-size: 17.018182px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #303038

g.text: 统计完整口令的相同字符串

text.style: font-size: 17.018182px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #303038

g.text: 结构人数＋结构内热门频次

text.style: font-size: 17.018182px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #303038

g.text: 秘密保存匿名位置对应关系

text.style: font-size: 16.363636px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #303038

g.text: 真实字符串保留在秘密计算内

text.style: font-size: 17.018182px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #303038

g.text: 三方噪声在秘密计算中相加

text.style: font-size: 17.018182px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #303038

g.text: 加噪后修正并发布统计

text.style: font-size: 18.327273px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #303038

g.text: 管理员查看加噪人数

text.style: font-size: 18.327273px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #303038

g.text: 与结构内匿名热门频次

text.style: font-size: 17.018182px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #303038

g.text: 先选结构，再补结构外热点

text.style: font-size: 17.018182px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #303038

g.text: 以快照和匿名位置指定限制

text.style: font-size: 16.363636px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #303038

g.text: 新发布扣减预算；同快照读缓存

text.style: font-size: 18.327273px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #303038

g.text: 注册／改密时私密检查

text.style: font-size: 18.327273px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #303038

g.text: 基础要求、结构与完整口令

text.style: font-size: 18.327273px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #303038

g.text: 仅返回合并的通过／拒绝

text.style: font-size: 18.327273px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #303038

g.text: 检查失败保留原统计

text.style: font-size: 18.327273px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #303038

g.text: 成功后增加新记录

text.style: font-size: 18.327273px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #303038

g.text: 改密同时撤销旧记录

text.style: font-size: 16.363636px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #303038

g.text: 更新秘密状态后按预算重新发布

text.style: font-size: 18.327273px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #303038

g.text: 成功更新秘密状态，下一次发布反映新分布

text.style: font-size: 17.018182px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #575764

g.text: 安全条件：客户端可信，三方独立管理、按协议执行，至多一方被动腐化
